purpose: Measure steady-state computational cost only after realized-error comparators have been frozen independently of timing. For 34 bracketed cases, time RossFast N1 and both Reference bracket endpoints N_lo/N_hi. For two left-censored B12 cases, time RossFast N1 and Reference N1 and report them separately.

rossfast.initialization: Material tables and solver binding are initialized once per case before warmup and excluded from primary timed regions.

reference.note: This is a research Richards comparator, not the current production Reference tolerance policy.
reference.bracketed: Time casewise frozen N_lo and N_hi from P2E23.
reference.left_censored: Time Reference N1 only; it is already more accurate than RossFast N1.

comparator_semantics.ref_high: P2E21 REF-HIGH is used only for untimed preflight verification and never inside a timed region.

execution_environment.workflow: single GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest job for the primary exposure
execution_environment.rule: All configurations for a case are timed in the same process and job.

warmup_and_batches.normalization: Every raw batch duration is divided by its fixed horizon repetition count before any ratio is calculated.
warmup_and_batches.rationale: Reference bracket controls can contain up to 24 outer segments; solver-specific fixed repetition counts provide measurable batch duration while keeping the physical horizon identical.
warmup_and_batches.order_schedule: The six bracketed orders above repeat exactly four times, yielding 24 measured batches. Left-censored pairs alternate [ROSS,REF_HI] and [REF_HI,ROSS] for 12 cycles.
warmup_and_batches.first_timing_exposure_rule: The first workflow that reaches measured timing is the primary timing exposure. Any later rerun is a reproducibility or infrastructure supplement and cannot be substituted silently.

clocks.primary: Fortran CPU_TIME around each complete batch
clocks.secondary: Fortran SYSTEM_CLOCK wall time around the same batch
clocks.timing_scope: Includes the complete configured solver horizon execution and route/mass/transfer validation. Excludes case construction, REF-HIGH reconstruction, RossFast table initialization, warmup and output formatting.

before_any_measured_batch: reproduce RossFast N1 endpoint and P2E23 realized error/storage gate untimed
reproduce frozen Reference N_lo/N_hi or N1 endpoint(s) untimed
verify route, integrated mass, prescribed transfer identity and P2E23 classification
preflight.failure_policy: If preflight does not reproduce the frozen scientific controls, the workflow fails before timing for that run. Do not change N_lo/N_hi or tolerances.

per_configuration_statistics.batch_records: Emit CPU and wall seconds per horizon for every measured batch.
per_configuration_statistics.primary_estimator: median of 24 CPU seconds-per-horizon batch values
per_configuration_statistics.secondary_estimator: median of 24 wall seconds-per-horizon batch values
per_configuration_statistics.variability: report median absolute deviation divided by median for CPU and wall separately
per_configuration_statistics.noisy_flag: flag, but do not exclude, a configuration when CPU MAD/median > 0.10

bracketed.scientific_meaning: Reference N_lo has just worse realized head/theta error than Ross; Reference N_hi has equal-or-better realized error. No runtime interpolation is used to fabricate an exact equal-error point.

left_censored.interpretation: Descriptive conservative comparison only because Reference N1 is already more accurate than RossFast N1 and no coarser tested Reference comparator exists.

summaries: median and geometric mean of R_LO over 34 bracketed cases
median and geometric mean of R_HI over 34 bracketed cases
interquartile range and min/max of both ratios
counts in the three preregistered cost classifications
population_analysis.censored_population: Report the two B12 cases separately and do not mix them into bracketed equal-error population summaries.

setup_cost.reason: The publication question is steady-state production solve cost over repeated model time windows; RossFast table/model initialization is a startup cost amortized across a simulation.
setup_cost.optional_secondary: A later separately labeled setup-cost measurement may be reported, but cannot alter the primary timing result.

outcome_policy.timing_noise: Retain noisy cases with flags; do not rerun selectively.
outcome_policy.partial_failure: If a scientific preflight fails, stop before measured timing in the primary run. If infrastructure fails after timing has begun, persist/identify the exposure and do not relabel a rerun as first exposure.
outcome_policy.interpretation: A timing result may support, refute, or leave unresolved a computational advantage. Scientific admission results remain valid regardless.
